posts.title: Our contact address is changing
posts.body: The alloystudiocontact address no longer works - please don't send anything there. A new contact address is coming soon and will appear on this page.

posts.title: Alloy accounts are rolling out
posts.body: There is now a Sign in button at the top of every page. One Alloy account works in every game, so progress follows you between devices instead of living in one browser. Orbit Dash is the first game on it; the rest of the catalogue moves over one at a time. Speed Simulator players: your existing login carries over, and so does your progress. Every save is checked on our server before it's kept, and accounts are what will power limited-time events.

posts.title: Counting visits, without cookies
posts.body: The site now keeps simple visit counts with GoatCounter, so we can see which games people actually find. It uses no cookies and collects no personal data - just page views, referring sites and rough location - which is also why there is no consent popup.

posts.title: Every game has a real thumbnail
posts.body: The generated colour tiles are gone. Every card in the library now shows a frame rendered from the game itself - staged mid-play, no text, built to still read at card size. Alloy Mind has also been retired from the catalogue.

posts.title: Every game in the catalogue is now reworked
posts.body: Hardburn and Rats With Wings arrive, replacing Anime Survivors and Neon Defense Grid. Echoes is rebuilt from scratch with three new tracks, Abyssal Dredging gets a real ocean under the rig, and Sole & Co. fixes the economy bug that made it unwinnable. Orbit Dash closes it out, rebuilt as an 18th-century brass orrery printed on cyanotype paper. That is the whole library caught up.

posts.title: Redwater arrives, four more games reworked
posts.body: Redwater replaces the old Blue Lock game outright - a top-down open-world western RPG where you ride in with no side and leave with one. Rivalforge is now Meridian - new name, new URL at /meridian/, and moved from a night-shift machine hall to high noon, with two new skin tiers and a reworked economy. Aura Fighters, Flytale and Multiverse Fighters are rebuilt too. Six games left on their original build.

posts.title: Seven games fully reworked
posts.body: Blox Fruits 2D is now Grand Line, a top-down pirate action-RPG, and Solo Leveling is now Rank Zero: Sovereign Protocol, fought on the page of an open book. Port Vesper, Neon Speed Simulator, Foil & Fortune, Cosmic Climb and Elementalis have all been rebuilt too. Open the full update log for what changed in each.

posts.title: Elementalis and Sole & Co. are live
posts.body: Two new games. Elementalis is a spellcasting action-RPG across the Broken Wilds, with a Grimoire for mastering and fusing elements. Sole & Co. is a sneaker shop sim - you inherit a two-metre-wide shop, three pairs and $1,500, and have to make rent.

posts.title: Three games added, contact address changed
posts.body: Multiverse Fighters, Flytale and Madballs join the catalogue, Alloy Mind gets a proper write-up, and Rivalforge and Neon Survivor Legends are updated to their latest builds.

posts.title: Rivalforge overhaul
posts.body: Rivalforge gets its biggest update yet in the calibration bay. Chain multipliers, optics calibration and a reworked scoring pass.

posts.title: Alloy Studios is live
posts.body: Every game now lives at one address, with one shared player: fullscreen, restart, and search across the whole library. Old per-game links redirect to their new home.
